cells.Item: INF-10  Wave runner and kit builder: one run sheet per wave (preflight, canaries, gates, caps, resume, RETURN.json)
cells.Closing criterion: cc.ps1 wave <id> runs a sheet on Uzair's machine: preflight checks code identity, disk, RAM and files; one canary per job runs first; gated jobs are skipped when their gate fails; a failing job stops only itself; RETURN.json is written incrementally with status, exit, code identity, output hashes, cost and wall time; the kit builder ships code, the engine cache and needed data to the agent's sandbox; unit tests
cells.Note: Adopted 19 Oct (docs/WAVES.md). Built in wave A; must show: a 3-job demo sheet with one gated skip and one failing canary.
